'''2015 Worlds Day 2 Joe Giannetti DS Jabba's Palace: Droid Workshop''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Giannetti]] at [[2015 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Giannetti]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
